messages:
marta: quick thread: thinking about an inline 'recommended filterset' feature for route pages. main goals: reduce token burn, avoid model-regressions, and make previewing low-friction. want to capture data-model + UX constraints before RFC.

reza: nice. two quick q's: 1) are recommendations ephemeral or persisted as suggested saved-queries? 2) compute cost of previewing?

marta: plan: we persist suggestions as lightweight records (id, candidates, provenance) and allow users to save them as saved-queries with a badge linking back to the suggestion. previews call sampling API to estimate impact; preview cost billed to infra budget but cached for X hours.

anya: what signals should feed the score? my vote: latency deltas (P50/P95), eval/regression deltas, traffic-model skew, and prompt-coverage checks. combine with a calibration factor so transient spikes don’t dominate.

devon: calibration is crucial. propose a simple approach: score = weighted_sum(raw_signals) * min(1, smoothing_factor) where smoothing_factor = 1 - exp(-traffic_volume/volume_scale). that downweights tiny-sample recommendations.

marta: good approach. previews must include: est_cost_delta_pct, p50/p95 change, n_samples, CI bounds, coverage_risk (low|med|high), and provenance_id for traceability. also include a small sanitized example set to help PMs validate.

ops-bot: stream-sugg job finished for route r-user (job=stream-sugg-20260617-4). generated 6 candidates.

reza: approval rules: anything that increases cost >12% or coverage_risk != low routes to approval (owner + finance). otherwise owners can quick-canary. also require audit events for apply/canary/rollback.

anya: rollout UX: three modes: preview (client-only simulation), canary (5-10% traffic with auto-monitor), and full (immediate, approval if needed). canary must wire to routing policy API and emit pre/post histograms. include 1-click rollback.

devon: preview API sketch:
POST /api/v1/routes/{id}/recommendations/preview
body: { "candidates": ["model:small-quant","region:eu"], "window": "72h", "simulate": true }
returns: { "suggestion_id": "s-1849-01", "est_cost_delta_pct": "-7.4", "p50_ms": "18", "p95_ms": "74", "ci_cost": "[-10.1,-4.2]", "n_samples": "420", "coverage_risk": "medium", "provenance_id": "trace-1849-01" }

marta: include a coverage_test that runs a small prompt corpus and returns coverage_loss_pct + examples. if coverage_loss_pct > 5% flag a warning.

ops-bot: note: preview samples may include cold-start bias; preview response will flag if bias_detected=true.

reza: telemetry/audit: store scoring inputs (traffic_entropy, cold_start_frac, eval_delta), sample_counts, and reference to sanitized request samples. store compressed trace by provenance_id for reproducibility.

anya: operational metrics: suggestion_adoption_rate, avg_realized_cost_delta, and quick_revert_rate_24h. surface these to ops so we can tune thresholds and weights.

devon: UI idea: compact card per suggestion with sparkline (pre/post p95), small badges (cost delta, coverage risk), a preview button that opens sample-impact modal, and apply dropdown (preview/canary/full). badge links to trace.

marta: perfect. I'll draft RFC with data model, preview API, apply flows, approval rules, telemetry snapshot schema, and ops metrics. can someone take a 2d spike to plumb preview->sampling API and a tiny UI mock?

anya: I can do the spike. thanks.

marta: cool, opening RFC after spike. :white_check_mark:
